description: A studio post-production supervisor must approve the final delivery package for a documentary trailer commissioned for an international film festival, including archival footage length, music selection, performer credit, caption format, frame rate, and clearance records.

shared_context.S1: The festival has requested a final documentary trailer package for delivery by Friday afternoon.
shared_context.S2: The current trailer draft contains 12 seconds of archival footage, uses the music cue 'Harbor Light,' credits the featured performer as 'Lena Ortiz,' offers optional captions, and is prepared at 24 frames per second.
shared_context.S3: Maya gives final approval for the package before it is delivered to the festival.
shared_context.S4: The production's normal final-approval routine is for the archive, music, talent, and accessibility leads to report any confirmed requirements before Maya signs off.

PF1.text: Elias confirmed with the archive lender yesterday that the archival footage license permits exactly 8 seconds in the trailer, not 12 seconds; the lender's email is still being attached to the rights file.

PF2.text: Nora confirmed with the music publisher this morning that 'Harbor Light' is not cleared for this trailer, while the alternate cue 'Paper Moons' is cleared for the festival delivery; she has not yet updated the music-clearance spreadsheet.

PF3.text: Jonah confirmed with Lena Ortiz's agent that the approved trailer credit must read exactly 'Lena Ortiz — Archive Performance'; the agent's approval is in an email thread that has not yet been added to the delivery checklist.

PF4.text: Priya's accessibility vendor confirmed that the festival ingest specification requires open captions and 25 frames per second for this title; the vendor issued the specification after the draft export was made and Priya has not yet revised the delivery sheet.

acceptance_conditions: The archival footage must be limited to exactly 8 seconds.
The trailer must use the cleared music cue 'Paper Moons.'
The performer credit must use the exact approved wording.
The delivery must contain open captions.
The export must be delivered at exactly 25 frames per second.
An archive-rights record must be added.
A music-clearance record must be added.
A talent-credit approval record must be added.
An accessibility-delivery record must be added.

content_checks.C6: any(c.get('target') == 'Elias' and ('rights file' in c.get('detail', '') or 'archive' in c.get('detail', '')) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any(c.get('target') == 'Nora' and 'music-clearance spreadsheet' in c.get('detail', '') for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: any(c.get('target') == 'Jonah' and 'delivery checklist' in c.get('detail', '') for c in commitments)
content_checks.C9: any(c.get('target') == 'Priya' and 'delivery sheet' in c.get('detail', '') for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The archival license changes the footage duration from the draft's 12 seconds to exactly 8 seconds and requires an archive-rights record.
The publisher confirmation changes the music from 'Harbor Light' to the cleared cue 'Paper Moons' and requires a music-clearance record.
The agent's approval changes the credit from 'Lena Ortiz' to exactly 'Lena Ortiz — Archive Performance' and requires a talent-credit record.
The festival ingest specification changes captions from optional to open, changes the frame rate from 24 to exactly 25, and requires an accessibility-delivery record.
